_comment: UnboundBot — Alpaca PAPER SWING (1h) executor config. This is a THIRD, DISJOINT order process running the 1h SwingAlt dispatcher over the PAPER-RELAXED wide-spread alt names (LTC/AVAX/DOGE) that FAIL the strict 0.5% cost/liquidity gate (owner-approved plan 2026-10-22). Because their ~1.1%+ round-trip cost would swamp a 5m edge, they trade on an hourly swing whose cost-aware -6% stop and multi-% moves are sized to clear that cost. dry_run=false sends REAL orders to the paper endpoint. It NEVER trades BTC or the fast-executor alts — those stay on their own disjoint configs. Do NOT run until the owner approves paper order flow.
_warning: If the ccxt url override ever fails, orders could target live. Verify the resolved endpoint with check_alpaca.py before trading. Rotate the exposed keys. This process shares the GLOBAL risk policy (paper_risk_policy.json), kill-switch, equity snapshot and the cross-executor open_exposure ledger with the daily and fast bots — the three whitelists are disjoint so the worst-case global exposure (BTC 15 + fast 6x10 + swing 3x10) stays under the min(105, 40%-equity) = $40 cap at $100. NOT started until the $100 daily path is verified.
_sizing_note: PAPER-RELAXED swing sizing (owner-approved plan 2026-10-22). stake_amount=10 is the per-pair base sized for a $100 balance; each of LTC/AVAX/DOGE is fractionable with a tiny base minimum so $10 clears the venue floor. SwingAlt inherits PaperAutonomous.custom_stake_amount + confirm_trade_entry, which enforce: per-pair cap 10, max planned loss 2, one position per pair, kill-switch, fresh-equity gate, and the GLOBAL exposure cap computed as this executor's own open stake PLUS the daily and fast executors' contributions read from app/state/open_exposure.json (fail-closed if that ledger is stale). Entries are automatic; unsafe ones are rejected and explained. PAPER ONLY — spot, long-only, no leverage.

exchange.name: alpaca
exchange._secrets_note: Keys are injected at runtime from D:\BOT\.env via FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY/SECRET by app/scripts/run_paper.py --swing. Never hardcode here (this file is committed).
exchange._ft_has_note: Alpaca is not a Freqtrade-native exchange; its ccxt fetch_ohlcv returns ONLY the current partial bar without a 'since' timestamp. ohlcv_require_since=true forces the historic-fetch path. Alpaca's crypto bars endpoint additionally caps each response to ~167 rows for 1h regardless of the caller's 'limit', and ccxt.alpaca does not paginate for Freqtrade, so the default ohlcv_candle_limit=500 makes the initial since land ~21 days back and the returned page ends ~10 days ago (never reaches NOW). Pin ohlcv_candle_limit_per_timeframe to 144 for 1h so the initial since = NOW-6d and the response covers current. Empirical repro in docs/Audit_2026-10-22.md sec.11.1.

telegram._note: Disabled to avoid the Telegram getUpdates Conflict with the daily bot (only one instance may poll a token). The read-only crypto_status_monitor sends this executor's 🟢/✅/🔴 trade alerts and per-asset status via sendMessage (it reads ALL THREE trade DBs), so the owner is still notified of every swing trade without a third polling bot.

_force_entry_note: Owner may enable force_entry + a localhost api_server to run a CONTROLLED test trade through the veto layer. Left OFF by default: forced entries are a testing affordance, not part of autonomous operation.
